Besetzung.et: From besetzen (“to place, fill, occupy”) + -ung. Compare Dutch bezetting (“occupation”).

Besen.et: From Middle High German bëseme, from Old High German bësamo, pësamo (“broom”), from Proto-West Germanic *besmō (“branch, rod, broom”).

besetzen.et:
From Middle High German besetzen, from Old High German bisezzen, from Proto-West Germanic *bisattjan, from Proto-Germanic *bisatjaną (“to set near; set around”), equivalent to be- + setzen.
Cognate with Saterland Frisian besätte, West Frisian besette, Dutch be…

besessen.et: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.

s: to dispose of (get rid of something), remove, eliminate
beseitigen.et: From now obsolete beseit (“aside”) (compare modern beiseite) + -igen.

besehen.et: From Middle High German besehen, from Old High German bisehan, from Proto-West Germanic *bisehwan, from Proto-Germanic *bisehwaną. Equivalent to be- + sehen.
